title.en: Aging Off TRICARE at 21 or 23? Coverage Options 2026
title.es: ¿Sale de TRICARE a los 21 o 23? Opciones de Cobertura 2026

description.en: TRICARE dependent coverage ends at 21 (or 23 for full-time students). Compare TYA, ACA Marketplace SEP, Medicaid, and CHCBP options for 2026.
description.es: La cobertura TRICARE de dependientes termina a los 21 (o 23 para estudiantes). Compare TYA, SEP del Mercado ACA, Medicaid y CHCBP para 2026.

h1.en: Aging Off TRICARE at 21 or 23? Here Are Your Health Insurance Options in 2026
h1.es: ¿Sale de TRICARE a los 21 o 23? Aqui Estan Sus Opciones de Seguro Medico en 2026

subhero.en: You have 60 days from losing TRICARE dependent coverage to enroll in an ACA Marketplace plan. Full-time college students may keep regular TRICARE until age 23, but the coverage cliff arrives either way.
subhero.es: Tiene 60 dias desde que pierde la cobertura de dependiente TRICARE para inscribirse en un plan del Mercado ACA. Los estudiantes universitarios de tiempo completo pueden mantener TRICARE regular hasta los 23, pero el precipicio de cobertura llega de todas formas.

heading.en: You have 60 days from your TRICARE coverage loss date
heading.es: Tiene 60 dias desde la fecha de perdida de su cobertura TRICARE

body.en: Your 60-day ACA Marketplace Special Enrollment Period starts the day after TRICARE dependent coverage ends. For example, if your TRICARE coverage ends June 30, 2026, your SEP window runs July 1 through August 29, 2026. Miss that window and you may have to wait until the next ACA Open Enrollment in November 2026. You also have 30 days to enroll in TRICARE Young Adult (TYA) from the date you lose regular TRICARE coverage.
body.es: Su Periodo de Inscripcion Especial del Mercado ACA de 60 dias comienza el dia despues de que termina la cobertura de dependiente TRICARE. Por ejemplo, si su cobertura TRICARE termina el 30 de junio de 2026, su ventana SEP va del 1 de julio al 29 de agosto de 2026. Si pierde esa ventana, puede tener que esperar hasta la proxima Inscripcion Abierta ACA en noviembre 2026. Tambien tiene 30 dias para inscribirse en TRICARE Young Adult (TYA) desde que pierde la cobertura TRICARE regular.

quickAnswer.en: Regular TRICARE dependent coverage ends when a military child turns 21 (or 23 if enrolled full-time in college with at least 50% financial support from a military sponsor). That coverage loss triggers a 60-day Special Enrollment Period for the ACA Marketplace. Your main options are: (1) TRICARE Young Adult (TYA) if you are unmarried, not eligible for employer-sponsored coverage, and under 26 (Prime costs $794/mo, Select costs $363/mo in 2026); (2) ACA Marketplace plan with subsidies, often $10 to $200/mo after premium tax credits; (3) Medicaid if your income is under 138% of the Federal Poverty Level; or (4) CHCBP bridge coverage at $2,103/quarter for 18 months as a short-term gap solution.
quickAnswer.es: La cobertura TRICARE de dependiente regular termina cuando el hijo militar cumple 21 anos (o 23 si esta matriculado a tiempo completo en la universidad con al menos 50% de apoyo financiero de un patrocinador militar). Esa perdida de cobertura activa un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias para el Mercado ACA. Sus opciones principales son: (1) TRICARE Young Adult (TYA) si es soltero, no es elegible para cobertura del empleador y tiene menos de 26 anos (Prime cuesta $794/mes, Select $363/mes en 2026); (2) plan del Mercado ACA con subsidios, a menudo $10 a $200/mes despues de creditos fiscales de prima; (3) Medicaid si su ingreso es menor al 138% del Nivel de Pobreza Federal; o (4) cobertura puente CHCBP a $2,103 por trimestre durante 18 meses como solucion temporal.

introParagraphs.en: TRICARE dependent coverage is one of the most generous health benefits available to military families, but it ends abruptly at age 21 for most children and age 23 for full-time college students. That cutoff, sometimes called the TRICARE young adult coverage cliff, often catches families off guard. Unlike civilian employer plans that follow the ACA's age-26 rule, TRICARE operates under a different federal statute that sets a lower age threshold. The good news: losing TRICARE dependent coverage qualifies as a loss-of-qualifying-health-coverage event under the ACA, which triggers a 60-day Special Enrollment Period (SEP) for the Marketplace. Most young adults who lose TRICARE at 21 or 23 have four realistic pathways: purchasing TRICARE Young Adult (TYA) as a premium-based continuation option, enrolling in an ACA Marketplace plan with subsidies, qualifying for Medicaid if income is low, or bridging through the Continued Health Care Benefit Program (CHCBP). Choosing the right option within the tight deadlines can save thousands of dollars per year.
introParagraphs.es: La cobertura TRICARE de dependiente es uno de los beneficios de salud mas generosos disponibles para familias militares, pero termina abruptamente a los 21 anos para la mayoria de los hijos y a los 23 para estudiantes universitarios de tiempo completo. Ese corte, a veces llamado el precipicio de cobertura de joven adulto TRICARE, a menudo toma desprevenidas a las familias. A diferencia de los planes civiles del empleador que siguen la regla de los 26 anos del ACA, TRICARE opera bajo un estatuto federal diferente que establece un umbral de edad mas bajo. La buena noticia: perder la cobertura de dependiente TRICARE califica como una perdida de cobertura de salud calificada bajo el ACA, lo que activa un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial (SEP) de 60 dias para el Mercado. La mayoria de los jovenes adultos que pierden TRICARE a los 21 o 23 tienen cuatro caminos realistas: comprar TRICARE Young Adult (TYA) como opcion de continuacion basada en primas, inscribirse en un plan del Mercado ACA con subsidios, calificar para Medicaid si el ingreso es bajo, o hacer un puente a traves del Programa de Beneficios de Salud Continua (CHCBP).

introParagraphs.en: Understanding the timing matters enormously. TRICARE coverage for standard dependents ends on the 21st birthday itself, not at the end of the birth month the way most ACA-governed employer plans work. For full-time college students with sponsor financial support exceeding 50%, coverage extends to age 23 or the date of graduation, whichever comes first. The 30-day TYA enrollment deadline runs from the date regular TRICARE ends, while the 60-day ACA Marketplace SEP window also starts from that loss date. Both clocks run simultaneously. Most young adults should compare ACA Marketplace costs against TYA before defaulting to TYA, because ACA subsidies based on the Medicaid income limits and ACA income limits often make Marketplace plans cheaper than TYA Select's $363/mo premium, especially at low incomes that would also trigger Medicaid eligibility. Check your options using the federal poverty level table below and the ACA income limits calculator to determine whether Medicaid or a subsidized Marketplace plan beats TYA on cost.
introParagraphs.es: Entender el momento es enormemente importante. La cobertura TRICARE para dependientes estandar termina el dia del 21 cumpleanos en si, no al final del mes de nacimiento como funciona con la mayoria de los planes del empleador regidos por el ACA. Para estudiantes universitarios de tiempo completo con apoyo financiero del patrocinador que excede el 50%, la cobertura se extiende hasta los 23 anos o la fecha de graduacion, lo que ocurra primero. El plazo de inscripcion TYA de 30 dias corre desde la fecha en que termina TRICARE regular, mientras que la ventana SEP del Mercado ACA de 60 dias tambien comienza desde esa fecha de perdida. Ambos relojes corren simultaneamente. La mayoria de los jovenes adultos deberian comparar los costos del Mercado ACA con TYA antes de optar automaticamente por TYA, porque los subsidios del ACA a menudo hacen que los planes del Mercado sean mas baratos que la prima de $363/mes de TYA Select, especialmente a bajos ingresos.

name.en: Confirm your exact TRICARE coverage end date
name.es: Confirme la fecha exacta de fin de su cobertura TRICARE

text.en: Log into milConnect at milconnect.dmdc.osd.mil or call your TRICARE regional contractor to verify when dependent coverage actually ends. Regular TRICARE ends on the 21st birthday for most dependents. For full-time college students with sponsor financial support, the end date is the 23rd birthday or graduation date, whichever comes first. Get this date in writing because it starts both your 30-day TYA enrollment window and your 60-day ACA Marketplace SEP clock.
text.es: Inicie sesion en milConnect en milconnect.dmdc.osd.mil o llame a su contratista regional TRICARE para verificar cuando termina realmente la cobertura de dependiente. TRICARE regular termina en el 21 cumpleanos para la mayoria de dependientes. Para estudiantes universitarios de tiempo completo con apoyo financiero del patrocinador, la fecha de fin es el 23 cumpleanos o la fecha de graduacion, lo que ocurra primero. Obtenga esta fecha por escrito porque inicia tanto su ventana de inscripcion TYA de 30 dias como su reloj SEP del Mercado ACA de 60 dias.

name.es: Calcule su ingreso proyectado del hogar para 2026

text.en: ACA Marketplace subsidies and Medicaid eligibility are both based on your projected Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) for 2026, not your parents' income. If you are a recent graduate starting your first job, use your projected annual earnings going forward. If you will earn under $22,025 as a single adult in a Medicaid expansion state, you qualify for free Medicaid and TYA is not worth paying for. If you earn $22,025 to $63,840, subsidized Marketplace plans are typically cheaper than TYA. If you earn over $63,840, the 400% FPL subsidy cliff applies in 2026 and TYA may be competitive.
text.es: Los subsidios del Mercado ACA y la elegibilidad para Medicaid se basan en su Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI) proyectado para 2026, no el ingreso de sus padres. Si es un recien graduado que comienza su primer trabajo, use sus ganancias anuales proyectadas en adelante. Si ganara menos de $22,025 como adulto soltero en un estado con expansion Medicaid, califica para Medicaid gratuito y no vale la pena pagar TYA. Si gana entre $22,025 y $63,840, los planes del Mercado con subsidios son tipicamente mas baratos que TYA.

name.es: Verifique primero la elegibilidad para Medicaid

text.en: In the 40 Medicaid expansion states plus DC, anyone under 138% FPL qualifies for free Medicaid year-round. For a single adult in 2026, that threshold is $22,025. Apply through healthcare.gov or your state Medicaid agency at any time. Medicaid has no enrollment window or premium, making it the best option if income qualifies. State programs use different brand names: California's Medi-Cal, Arizona's AHCCCS, Massachusetts's MassHealth, Wisconsin's BadgerCare, and New Jersey's NJ FamilyCare all accept applications year-round at no cost.
text.es: En los 40 estados con expansion Medicaid mas DC, cualquier persona bajo el 138% FPL califica para Medicaid gratuito todo el ano. Para un adulto soltero en 2026, ese umbral es $22,025. Aplique a traves de healthcare.gov o su agencia estatal de Medicaid en cualquier momento. Los programas estatales usan diferentes nombres: Medi-Cal de California, AHCCCS de Arizona, MassHealth de Massachusetts, BadgerCare de Wisconsin y NJ FamilyCare de Nueva Jersey aceptan solicitudes todo el ano sin costo.

name.en: Compare TYA against an ACA Marketplace plan
name.es: Compare TYA con un plan del Mercado ACA

text.en: TRICARE Young Adult comes in two options: TYA-Prime at $794/mo (requires a primary care manager and referrals, limited to Prime Service Areas for retiree sponsors) and TYA-Select at $363/mo (allows any TRICARE-authorized provider without referrals, available nationally). Compare these against subsidized ACA Marketplace Silver plans using healthcare.gov's plan finder. For most incomes between 138% and 300% FPL in 2026, ACA Silver plans with cost-sharing reductions and premium tax credits will cost less than TYA-Select. Above 400% FPL, TYA-Select may be competitive depending on your ZIP code.
text.es: TRICARE Young Adult viene en dos opciones: TYA-Prime a $794/mes (requiere un administrador de atencion primaria y referencias, limitado a Areas de Servicio Prime para patrocinadores jubilados) y TYA-Select a $363/mes (permite cualquier proveedor autorizado por TRICARE sin referencias, disponible a nivel nacional). Compare estos con los planes Silver del Mercado ACA con subsidios usando el buscador de planes de healthcare.gov. Para la mayoria de ingresos entre el 138% y el 300% FPL en 2026, los planes Silver del ACA con reducciones de costo compartido y creditos fiscales de prima costaran menos que TYA-Select.

name.en: Enroll in TYA within 30 days (if choosing TYA)
name.es: Inscribase en TYA dentro de 30 dias (si elige TYA)

text.en: To enroll in TRICARE Young Adult, log into milConnect and use the Beneficiary Web Enrollment (BWE) portal, or call your TRICARE regional contractor: East Region at 1-800-444-5445 or West Region at 1-888-TRIWEST (874-9378). Submit DD Form 2947 with your initial two-month premium payment if applying by fax or mail. Your application must be received within 30 days of losing other TRICARE coverage. TYA is available to unmarried adult children of eligible sponsors who are ages 21 to 26 and not eligible for employer-sponsored health insurance.
text.es: Para inscribirse en TRICARE Young Adult, inicie sesion en milConnect y use el portal de Inscripcion Web de Beneficiarios (BWE), o llame a su contratista regional TRICARE: Region Este al 1-800-444-5445 o Region Oeste al 1-888-TRIWEST (874-9378). Envie el Formulario DD 2947 con su pago inicial de dos meses de prima si aplica por fax o correo. Su solicitud debe recibirse dentro de los 30 dias de perder otra cobertura TRICARE.

name.en: Enroll in an ACA Marketplace plan within 60 days (if not choosing TYA)
name.es: Inscribase en un plan del Mercado ACA dentro de 60 dias (si no elige TYA)

text.en: Apply at healthcare.gov using your Loss-of-Coverage Special Enrollment Period. Select 'I lost or will soon lose health coverage' and enter your TRICARE coverage end date. The SEP window is 60 days from your coverage loss date. You will need to provide documentation of TRICARE coverage loss, such as a TRICARE disenrollment notice or a letter confirming your coverage end date from your regional contractor. ACA Marketplace coverage is available to all lawfully present residents regardless of military family status.
text.es: Aplique en healthcare.gov usando su Periodo de Inscripcion Especial por Perdida de Cobertura. Seleccione 'Perdi o pronto perdere cobertura de salud' e ingrese su fecha de fin de cobertura TRICARE. La ventana SEP es de 60 dias desde la fecha de perdida de cobertura. Necesitara documentacion de la perdida de cobertura TRICARE, como un aviso de desinscripcion de TRICARE o una carta confirmando su fecha de fin de cobertura de su contratista regional.

name.en: Consider CHCBP only as a short-term bridge
name.es: Considere CHCBP solo como un puente a corto plazo

text.en: The Continued Health Care Benefit Program (CHCBP) is a premium-based continuation of TRICARE coverage available for up to 18 months after losing TRICARE eligibility. CHCBP premiums in 2026 are $2,103 per quarter for an individual ($701/mo equivalent). Purchase CHCBP within 60 days of TRICARE loss through Humana Military at 1-800-444-5445. CHCBP costs significantly more than TYA-Select and most ACA Marketplace plans with subsidies, making it primarily useful if you are between job offers or awaiting employer benefits activation.
text.es: El Programa de Beneficios de Salud Continua (CHCBP) es una continuacion de la cobertura TRICARE basada en primas disponible por hasta 18 meses despues de perder la elegibilidad TRICARE. Las primas CHCBP en 2026 son $2,103 por trimestre para un individuo ($701/mes equivalente). Compre CHCBP dentro de los 60 dias de la perdida de TRICARE a traves de Humana Military al 1-800-444-5445. CHCBP cuesta significativamente mas que TYA-Select y la mayoria de planes del Mercado ACA con subsidios.

intro.en: The costliest mistakes military families make when a young adult ages off TRICARE:
intro.es: Los errores mas costosos que cometen las familias militares cuando un joven adulto sale de TRICARE:

items.en: Defaulting to TYA without comparing Marketplace costs. TYA-Select at $363/mo is often more expensive than a subsidized ACA Marketplace Silver plan for someone earning under $45,000/year in 2026. Run the comparison at healthcare.gov before enrolling in TYA.
items.es: Optar automaticamente por TYA sin comparar costos del Mercado. TYA-Select a $363/mes es frecuentemente mas caro que un plan Silver del Mercado ACA con subsidios para alguien que gana menos de $45,000/ano en 2026. Haga la comparacion en healthcare.gov antes de inscribirse en TYA.

items.en: Missing the 30-day TYA enrollment deadline. TYA requires enrollment within 30 days of losing regular TRICARE coverage (when transitioning from regular TRICARE to TYA). The 60-day window applies only to the ACA Marketplace SEP. Missing the 30-day TYA deadline means TYA is no longer available until the next qualifying event.
items.es: Perder el plazo de inscripcion TYA de 30 dias. TYA requiere inscripcion dentro de los 30 dias de perder la cobertura TRICARE regular. El plazo de 60 dias aplica solo al SEP del Mercado ACA. Perder el plazo de 30 dias de TYA significa que TYA ya no esta disponible hasta el proximo evento calificador.

items.en: Not checking Medicaid first. A recent graduate or part-time worker earning under $22,025 in 2026 qualifies for free Medicaid in expansion states. Medicaid enrollment is year-round with no premium, making it the best option if income qualifies.
items.es: No verificar Medicaid primero. Un recien graduado o trabajador a tiempo parcial que gana menos de $22,025 en 2026 califica para Medicaid gratuito en estados con expansion. La inscripcion en Medicaid es todo el ano sin prima, lo que la convierte en la mejor opcion si el ingreso califica.

items.en: Assuming TYA is the only TRICARE continuation option. CHCBP is a separate bridge program available for 60 days from TRICARE loss, useful if you have a job offer pending and just need short-term coverage until employer benefits start.
items.es: Asumir que TYA es la unica opcion de continuacion de TRICARE. CHCBP es un programa puente separado disponible por 60 dias desde la perdida de TRICARE, util si tiene una oferta de trabajo pendiente y solo necesita cobertura a corto plazo hasta que comiencen los beneficios del empleador.

items.en: Assuming TYA is available even with an employer plan. TYA explicitly requires that you are not eligible for employer-sponsored health insurance through your own employment. Getting a job that offers health benefits disqualifies you from TYA, even mid-year.
items.es: Asumir que TYA esta disponible incluso con un plan del empleador. TYA requiere explicitamente que no sea elegible para seguro medico patrocinado por el empleador a traves de su propio empleo. Conseguir un trabajo que ofrezca beneficios de salud lo descalifica de TYA, incluso a mitad de ano.

items.en: Missing the 60-day ACA Marketplace SEP window entirely. Without a qualifying life event SEP, you cannot enroll in a Marketplace plan outside of Open Enrollment (November 1, 2026 to January 15, 2027 for 2027 coverage). A coverage gap of months means any medical care is paid entirely out of pocket.
items.es: Perder la ventana SEP del Mercado ACA de 60 dias por completo. Sin un SEP de evento calificador de vida, no puede inscribirse en un plan del Mercado fuera de la Inscripcion Abierta (1 de noviembre de 2026 al 15 de enero de 2027 para cobertura 2027). Una brecha de cobertura de meses significa que cualquier atencion medica se paga completamente de su bolsillo.

heading.en: TYA vs ACA Marketplace vs Medicaid: Which Should You Choose After Aging Off TRICARE?
heading.es: TYA vs Mercado ACA vs Medicaid: Cual Debe Elegir Despues de Salir de TRICARE?

body.en: TRICARE Young Adult, ACA Marketplace plans, and Medicaid each serve a different income band after a young adult loses regular TRICARE coverage. TYA premiums are flat regardless of income: TYA-Prime costs $794/mo and TYA-Select costs $363/mo in 2026. Neither adjusts based on how much you earn. ACA Marketplace plans, by contrast, apply premium tax credits that scale with income, making them significantly cheaper for most earners in the $22,025 to $63,840 range (138% to 400% FPL for a single adult in 2026). A 22-year-old earning $28,000 per year in 2026 would typically pay less than $80/mo for a subsidized Silver plan at healthcare.gov, compared to $363/mo for TYA-Select. Medicaid is the correct first check: anyone earning under $22,025 as a single adult in one of the 40 expansion states plus DC qualifies for free comprehensive Medicaid coverage year-round, with no enrollment deadline. The decision framework is: Medicaid first (free, year-round if income is under 138% FPL); then ACA Marketplace with subsidies for incomes between 138% and 400% FPL; then TYA-Select for those above 400% FPL who want to keep a TRICARE-authorized provider network or for those earning higher incomes who find the flat TYA premium competitive; CHCBP only as a short-term bridge of 60 days or less before a better option is available. TYA's real advantage is provider continuity: TRICARE-authorized providers are the same network used under regular TRICARE, meaning no change in doctors for a young adult who has long-standing care relationships within the military health system.
body.es: TRICARE Young Adult, los planes del Mercado ACA y Medicaid sirven cada uno a una franja de ingresos diferente despues de que un joven adulto pierde la cobertura TRICARE regular. Las primas TYA son fijas independientemente de los ingresos: TYA-Prime cuesta $794/mes y TYA-Select cuesta $363/mes en 2026. Ninguno se ajusta segun cuanto gane. Los planes del Mercado ACA, por el contrario, aplican creditos fiscales de prima que se escalan con los ingresos, haciendolos significativamente mas baratos para la mayoria de personas que ganan entre $22,025 y $63,840 (138% a 400% FPL para un adulto soltero en 2026). Un joven de 22 anos que gana $28,000 anuales en 2026 tipicamente pagaria menos de $80/mes por un plan Silver con subsidios en healthcare.gov, en comparacion con $363/mes para TYA-Select. Medicaid es la primera verificacion correcta: cualquier persona que gane menos de $22,025 como adulto soltero en uno de los 40 estados con expansion mas DC califica para cobertura Medicaid gratuita y completa todo el ano, sin plazo de inscripcion. El marco de decision es: Medicaid primero (gratis, todo el ano si el ingreso es menor al 138% FPL); luego el Mercado ACA con subsidios para ingresos entre 138% y 400% FPL; luego TYA-Select para los que esten por encima del 400% FPL que quieran mantener una red de proveedores autorizada por TRICARE; CHCBP solo como un puente a corto plazo de 60 dias o menos.

heading.en: The TRICARE Age-Out Cliff: Age 21 vs Age 23 Explained
heading.es: El Precipicio de Salida de TRICARE: Los 21 vs los 23 Anos Explicados

paragraphs.en: TRICARE dependent coverage does not follow the ACA's age-26 rule. Federal law governing TRICARE (10 U.S.C. Section 1072) sets a lower threshold, ending regular dependent coverage at age 21. The sole exception for a later cutoff: a child must be enrolled full-time at an accredited institution of higher learning AND the military sponsor must provide more than 50% of the child's financial support. Meeting both conditions extends TRICARE through the 23rd birthday or the date of graduation, whichever comes first. Partial enrollment, online-only programs that are not accredited, or financial independence from the sponsor all eliminate the age-23 extension. Military families should confirm annually with DEERS (Defense Enrollment Eligibility Reporting System) whether the student still meets the extension criteria. DEERS updates can be made by calling 1-800-538-9552 or visiting a uniformed services ID card office.
paragraphs.es: La cobertura de dependiente TRICARE no sigue la regla de los 26 anos del ACA. La ley federal que rige TRICARE (10 U.S.C. Seccion 1072) establece un umbral mas bajo, terminando la cobertura regular de dependiente a los 21 anos. La unica excepcion para un corte posterior: el hijo debe estar matriculado a tiempo completo en una institucion acreditada de educacion superior Y el patrocinador militar debe proporcionar mas del 50% del apoyo financiero del hijo. Cumplir ambas condiciones extiende TRICARE hasta el 23 cumpleanos o la fecha de graduacion, lo que ocurra primero.

paragraphs.en: Losing TRICARE at 21 or 23 is classified by CMS and healthcare.gov as a loss of qualifying minimum essential coverage, which triggers the same 60-day ACA Marketplace Special Enrollment Period available to anyone who loses other government health coverage (such as Medicaid or an employer plan). The SEP clock starts the day after coverage ends. You can also apply for the SEP up to 60 days in advance if you know your coverage end date. Military children who lose TRICARE in the middle of a plan year should act immediately: the 60-day clock runs even if you do not receive formal notification from TRICARE, and missing it forfeits access to subsidized Marketplace plans until the next ACA Open Enrollment in November 2026.
paragraphs.es: Perder TRICARE a los 21 o 23 es clasificado por CMS y healthcare.gov como una perdida de cobertura minima esencial calificada, lo que activa el mismo Periodo de Inscripcion Especial del Mercado ACA de 60 dias disponible para cualquier persona que pierde otra cobertura de salud gubernamental. El reloj SEP comienza el dia despues de que termina la cobertura. Tambien puede solicitar el SEP con hasta 60 dias de anticipacion si conoce su fecha de fin de cobertura.

heading.en: Medicaid Eligibility After Losing TRICARE in 2026
heading.es: Elegibilidad para Medicaid Despues de Perder TRICARE en 2026

paragraphs.en: Losing TRICARE at 21 or 23 often coincides with starting a first job, graduating college, or entering a period of lower income that creates Medicaid eligibility for the first time. Medicaid is income-gated at 138% FPL in the 40 expansion states plus DC. For 2026, that means $22,025 for a single person and $45,540 for a family of four. State programs have distinct brand names that matter for enrollment: California's Medi-Cal, Arizona's AHCCCS, Massachusetts's MassHealth, Wisconsin's BadgerCare, New Jersey's NJ FamilyCare, Connecticut's HUSKY Health, and Oregon Health Plan all use the same 138% FPL expansion threshold. The 10 non-expansion states (Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Kansas, Mississippi, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Wisconsin prior to expansion, Wyoming) generally do not cover non-disabled adults below 100% FPL, leaving a coverage gap that neither Medicaid nor ACA subsidies can fill. Apply year-round at healthcare.gov or your state Medicaid agency. Medicaid enrollment is not subject to the 60-day SEP window.
paragraphs.es: Perder TRICARE a los 21 o 23 a menudo coincide con comenzar un primer trabajo, graduarse de la universidad o entrar en un periodo de ingresos mas bajos que crea elegibilidad para Medicaid por primera vez. Medicaid tiene umbral de ingresos al 138% FPL en los 40 estados con expansion mas DC. Para 2026, eso significa $22,025 para una sola persona y $45,540 para una familia de cuatro. Los programas estatales tienen nombres de marca distintos: Medi-Cal de California, AHCCCS de Arizona, MassHealth de Massachusetts, BadgerCare de Wisconsin, NJ FamilyCare de Nueva Jersey, HUSKY Health de Connecticut y Oregon Health Plan todos usan el mismo umbral de expansion del 138% FPL.

heading.en: TYA Eligibility Rules: Who Qualifies and Who Does Not
heading.es: Reglas de Elegibilidad TYA: Quien Califica y Quien No

paragraphs.en: TRICARE Young Adult has stricter eligibility rules than the ACA's age-26 dependent coverage standard. Four conditions must all be met simultaneously: (1) the applicant must be unmarried; (2) must be between ages 21 and 26 (or 23 and 26 for those who used the student extension); (3) must not be otherwise eligible for regular TRICARE coverage; and (4) must not be eligible for employer-sponsored health insurance through their own employment. The employer-sponsored-coverage disqualifier is the most commonly misunderstood rule. Getting a job that offers health benefits, even if you decline to enroll, eliminates TYA eligibility. Seasonal or part-time employment that technically offers minimum essential coverage also counts. If eligibility is lost mid-year (because you marry, get a job with benefits, or turn 26), TYA coverage ends immediately and a 12-month purchase lockout applies if the termination was voluntary. Military sponsors must be active duty, retired, activated or non-activated Guard and Reserve members, or certain unremarried former spouses.
paragraphs.es: TRICARE Young Adult tiene reglas de elegibilidad mas estrictas que el estandar de cobertura de dependiente hasta los 26 anos del ACA. Cuatro condiciones deben cumplirse simultneamente: (1) el solicitante debe ser soltero; (2) debe tener entre 21 y 26 anos (o 23 y 26 para los que usaron la extension estudiantil); (3) no debe ser elegible para cobertura TRICARE regular; y (4) no debe ser elegible para seguro medico patrocinado por el empleador a traves de su propio empleo. El descalificador de cobertura patrocinada por el empleador es la regla mas frecuentemente malentendida. Conseguir un trabajo que ofrezca beneficios de salud, incluso si rechaza inscribirse, elimina la elegibilidad TYA.

en.question: When exactly does regular TRICARE coverage end for a dependent child?
en.answer: Regular TRICARE dependent coverage ends on the dependent's 21st birthday under 10 U.S.C. Section 1072. The only exception: if the child is enrolled full-time at an accredited institution of higher learning AND the military sponsor provides more than 50% financial support, coverage can extend to the 23rd birthday or graduation date, whichever comes first. Unlike ACA-governed plans that run through the end of the birth month, TRICARE ends on the actual birthday. Confirm your exact end date with DEERS at 1-800-538-9552 or through milConnect.

en.question: How long is the TRICARE Young Adult enrollment window after losing regular TRICARE?
en.answer: You must submit your TYA application and initial two-month premium payment within 30 days of losing regular TRICARE dependent coverage. This is a strict deadline. If you miss the 30-day TYA window, you cannot enroll in TYA until the next qualifying event occurs (such as becoming eligible again due to a sponsor status change). The ACA Marketplace SEP window is separate and longer at 60 days. You may be pursuing both options simultaneously.

en.question: Is TYA cheaper than an ACA Marketplace plan after losing TRICARE at 21?
en.answer: For most young adults at typical early-career incomes, ACA Marketplace plans with subsidies are cheaper than TYA. TYA-Select costs $363/mo in 2026 with no income adjustment. A 21-year-old earning $30,000/year in 2026 typically qualifies for premium tax credits that bring a Silver Marketplace plan to $50 to $120/mo. At incomes above 400% FPL (about $63,840 for a single adult in 2026), subsidies phase out and TYA-Select becomes more price-competitive. Use the healthcare.gov plan finder to compare actual quotes for your ZIP code before enrolling in TYA.

en.question: Does getting a job disqualify me from TYA?
en.answer: Yes, if your employer offers health insurance. TYA eligibility requires that you are not eligible for employer-sponsored health insurance through your own employment. If you get a job that offers a qualifying health plan, you lose TYA eligibility even if you choose not to enroll in the employer plan. This is different from the ACA's age-26 dependent rule, which does not have an employer-offer disqualifier. If you lose a job and lose access to employer coverage, you may regain TYA eligibility if you are still under 26 and meet the other criteria.

en.question: What is the CHCBP and is it worth buying after TRICARE ends?
en.answer: The Continued Health Care Benefit Program (CHCBP) is a temporary bridge that extends TRICARE-equivalent coverage for up to 18 months after you lose TRICARE eligibility. Purchase it within 60 days of TRICARE loss through Humana Military at 1-800-444-5445. CHCBP costs $2,103 per quarter in 2026, roughly $701/mo, which is nearly double TYA-Select's $363/mo premium and far more than most subsidized Marketplace plans. CHCBP is worth considering only if you need coverage for 60 days or less while waiting for employer benefits to start, or if you are briefly ineligible for both TYA and the Marketplace SEP.

en.question: What documents do I need to prove TRICARE loss for the ACA Marketplace SEP?
en.answer: Healthcare.gov requires documentation of TRICARE coverage loss to activate the loss-of-coverage SEP. Acceptable documents include a TRICARE disenrollment notice, a letter from your TRICARE regional contractor confirming your coverage end date, or a printout from milConnect showing TRICARE eligibility has ended. You must submit this documentation within 30 days of selecting a Marketplace plan, or your enrollment may be cancelled. If you do not have documentation ready, contact your TRICARE regional contractor: East Region 1-800-444-5445 or West Region 1-888-874-9378.

en.question: Can I qualify for Medicaid if I just lost TRICARE at 21?
en.answer: Yes, if your income qualifies. In the 40 Medicaid expansion states plus DC, anyone whose projected 2026 income is under 138% FPL qualifies for free Medicaid year-round. For a single adult in 2026, that threshold is $22,025. Many recent college graduates or part-time workers who lose TRICARE at 21 or 23 fall below this level during their first year post-TRICARE. Apply at healthcare.gov or your state Medicaid agency at any time. Medicaid is not bound by the 60-day SEP deadline. State-named programs include Medi-Cal (California), AHCCCS (Arizona), MassHealth (Massachusetts), and BadgerCare (Wisconsin).

en.question: What happens when TYA itself ends at age 26?
en.answer: TRICARE Young Adult coverage ends on the day you turn 26. Turning 26 is a qualifying life event that triggers a 60-day Special Enrollment Period for the ACA Marketplace. The process is the same as losing any other qualifying health coverage: apply at healthcare.gov, select the loss-of-coverage SEP, and submit documentation showing TYA coverage has ended. You may also be eligible to enroll in an employer plan within 30 days of the TYA loss date if your employer offers coverage. Medicaid enrollment remains year-round if income qualifies.

es.question: Cuando exactamente termina la cobertura TRICARE regular para un hijo dependiente?
es.answer: La cobertura de dependiente TRICARE regular termina en el 21 cumpleanos del dependiente bajo 10 U.S.C. Seccion 1072. La unica excepcion: si el hijo esta matriculado a tiempo completo en una institucion acreditada de educacion superior Y el patrocinador militar proporciona mas del 50% de apoyo financiero, la cobertura puede extenderse hasta el 23 cumpleanos o la fecha de graduacion, lo que ocurra primero. A diferencia de los planes regidos por el ACA que corren hasta el final del mes de nacimiento, TRICARE termina en el cumpleanos real. Confirme su fecha exacta de fin con DEERS al 1-800-538-9552 o a traves de milConnect.

es.question: Cual es la ventana de inscripcion de TRICARE Young Adult despues de perder TRICARE regular?
es.answer: Debe enviar su solicitud TYA y el pago inicial de dos meses de prima dentro de los 30 dias de perder la cobertura de dependiente TRICARE regular. Este es un plazo estricto. Si pierde la ventana de 30 dias de TYA, no puede inscribirse en TYA hasta que ocurra el proximo evento calificador. La ventana SEP del Mercado ACA es separada y mas larga a 60 dias. Puede estar persiguiendo ambas opciones simultaneamente.

es.question: Es TYA mas barato que un plan del Mercado ACA despues de perder TRICARE a los 21?
es.answer: Para la mayoria de jovenes adultos con ingresos tipicos al inicio de carrera, los planes del Mercado ACA con subsidios son mas baratos que TYA. TYA-Select cuesta $363/mes en 2026 sin ajuste de ingresos. Un joven de 21 anos que gana $30,000 anuales en 2026 tipicamente califica para creditos fiscales de prima que llevan un plan Silver del Mercado a $50 a $120/mes. A ingresos superiores al 400% FPL (aproximadamente $63,840 para un adulto soltero en 2026), los subsidios se eliminan gradualmente y TYA-Select se vuelve mas competitivo en precio.

es.question: Conseguir un trabajo me descalifica de TYA?
es.answer: Si, si su empleador ofrece seguro medico. La elegibilidad TYA requiere que no sea elegible para seguro medico patrocinado por el empleador a traves de su propio empleo. Si consigue un trabajo que ofrece un plan de salud calificado, pierde la elegibilidad TYA incluso si elige no inscribirse en el plan del empleador. Esto es diferente de la regla de dependiente de los 26 anos del ACA, que no tiene un descalificador de oferta del empleador.

es.question: Que es CHCBP y vale la pena comprarlo despues de que termine TRICARE?
es.answer: El Programa de Beneficios de Salud Continua (CHCBP) es un puente temporal que extiende la cobertura equivalente a TRICARE por hasta 18 meses despues de perder la elegibilidad TRICARE. Comprelo dentro de los 60 dias de la perdida de TRICARE a traves de Humana Military al 1-800-444-5445. CHCBP cuesta $2,103 por trimestre en 2026, aproximadamente $701/mes, casi el doble de la prima de $363/mes de TYA-Select y mucho mas que la mayoria de planes del Mercado con subsidios. CHCBP vale la pena considerar solo si necesita cobertura por 60 dias o menos mientras espera que comiencen los beneficios del empleador.

es.question: Que documentos necesito para probar la perdida de TRICARE para el SEP del Mercado ACA?
es.answer: Healthcare.gov requiere documentacion de la perdida de cobertura TRICARE para activar el SEP por perdida de cobertura. Los documentos aceptables incluyen un aviso de desinscripcion de TRICARE, una carta de su contratista regional TRICARE confirmando su fecha de fin de cobertura, o una impresion de milConnect que muestre que la elegibilidad TRICARE ha terminado. Debe enviar esta documentacion dentro de los 30 dias de seleccionar un plan del Mercado, o su inscripcion puede cancelarse.

es.question: Puedo calificar para Medicaid si acabo de perder TRICARE a los 21?
es.answer: Si, si su ingreso califica. En los 40 estados con expansion Medicaid mas DC, cualquier persona cuyo ingreso proyectado para 2026 sea menor al 138% FPL califica para Medicaid gratuito todo el ano. Para un adulto soltero en 2026, ese umbral es $22,025. Muchos recien graduados universitarios o trabajadores a tiempo parcial que pierden TRICARE a los 21 o 23 caen por debajo de este nivel durante su primer ano post-TRICARE. Aplique en healthcare.gov o su agencia estatal de Medicaid en cualquier momento.

es.question: Que pasa cuando TYA en si termina a los 26 anos?
es.answer: La cobertura de TRICARE Young Adult termina el dia que cumple 26 anos. Cumplir 26 es un evento calificador de vida que activa un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias para el Mercado ACA. El proceso es el mismo que perder cualquier otra cobertura de salud calificada: aplique en healthcare.gov, seleccione el SEP por perdida de cobertura y envie documentacion que muestre que la cobertura TYA ha terminado. Tambien puede ser elegible para inscribirse en un plan del empleador dentro de los 30 dias de la fecha de perdida de TYA.
